additionalPatternFoundNotFixedThisPhase.disposition: Same gap, but this module is under a mechanically-enforced independence contract (tests/contract-model/coverage-audit-independence.test.ts) that forbids importing amendment/* - fixing it the named way would require relaxing a deliberate architecture invariant. Flagged, not touched - same disposition class as P1-10's own prior architecture-change-required category, but resolved this time by finding a fix that does NOT require relaxing the invariant (see design below).

Its own gap: when input.operativeState is null, it silently produces zero findings (fails OPEN, not closed). Disclosed, not fixed - out of the two-named-files scope.
Same raw-text pattern; this subsystem is Workstream E's territory from a prior phase (CTX-01/CTX-02) - not touched.

designChosen: Option (b), the functional/service-boundary fix - not a StructuralNode schema field. StructuralNode is a plain in-memory TypeScript interface with 26+ consumers mapped to Prisma's DocumentNode only inside persistence.ts; a schema-level flag would ripple through persistence and every consumer for no real benefit.

implementation.newTypes: amendment/types.ts: NodeSupersessionStatus (CURRENT_OPERATIVE | KNOWN_SUPERSEDED | UNKNOWN_SUPERSESSION_STATUS), NodeSupersessionRecord, NodeSupersessionResult, NodeSupersessionIndex.
implementation.newFunctions: amendment/operative-state.ts: buildNodeSupersessionIndex(entries) (generalizes the ad hoc nodeId-keyed lookup cross-reference-audit.ts already does, into a reusable O(1) index covering multiple instruments), getNodeSupersessionStatus(index, documentId, nodeId) (the fail-closed three-way query primitive - no nodeId, ambiguous target, or uncovered document all resolve UNKNOWN, never CURRENT_OPERATIVE), EMPTY_SUPERSESSION_INDEX (the safe default).
implementation.wiredConsumers: discovery/pass-a-signals.ts + pipeline.ts: new optional trailing supersessionIndex param; every DeterministicCandidate now carries supersessionStatus/supersessionReason. semantic-verification/source-inventory.ts + verify.ts: new optional structuralNodeId/supersessionIndex params; determineStatus downgrades to REVIEW_REQUIRED only on an affirmed KNOWN_SUPERSEDED verdict, never on UNKNOWN.
implementation.backwardCompatibility: All new params are optional/trailing - every existing call site (production and ~30 test call sites) compiles and behaves unchanged.

historicalVsOperativeDistinction: Superseded nodes remain generated as candidates - history stays queryable (Section 12's own historicalQueryability requirement) - they are just honestly labeled rather than silently treated as current.
